summary.en: The military court sentenced 66 Congolese soldiers to death for cowardice and mutiny after they fled fighting FRN rebels, intensifying pressure on the FARDC as the FRN advances on multiple fronts. ISIS-linked militants killed 33 people, causing patients to flee a hospital and raising concerns about Ebola spread. Allied Democratic Forces militants attacked Cantine in North Kivu, further destabilising the area. The WHO warned that cholera has killed 1,800 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Battle-related deaths totaled 1,158 in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den militære domstolen dømte 66 kongolesiske soldater til døden for feighet og opprør etter at de flyktet fra kamp mot FRN-rebeller, noe som øker presset på FARDC mens FRN rykker frem på flere fronter. ISIS-tilknyttede militante drepte 33 personer, noe som fikk pasienter til å flykte fra et sykehus og skapte bekymring for spredning av ebola. Allierte demokratiske styrker (ADF) angrep Cantine i Nord-Kivu, noe som ytterligere destabiliserer området. WHO advarte om at kolera har drept 1 800 personer i Den demokratiske republikken Kongo. Dødsfall knyttet til kamper beløp seg til 1 158 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
